verdict.rationale: The evidence pack is almost entirely Gemini Apps (consumer chatbot) documentation—image generation, Gemini Live, Deep Research, connected apps—none of which addresses official SDKs for building applications. Community threads mention API pricing, a Gemini CLI, and Google AI Studio settings, but there is no first-party SDK documentation (e.g., Python/Node/Go client libraries) cited anywhere in the pack, and the probe explicitly notes the consumer app has no agent-docs/API discovery surface tied to it.
